title: DR1 tells the user which slice of the list they are looking at — "Show 1-4 of 4 results" — where the frontend says only "Showing 1 Result".

finding.frontend: Above the list the frontend prints one of four phrasings depending on how many notifications there are: "No Results", "Showing 1 Result", "Showing 1 of 4 Results" or "Showing 1 to 10 of 23 Results" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:40-46, rendered at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/template.njk:61). The single-result case drops the total, so a user who has filtered down to one is not told how many they started with, and Result and Results are capitalised mid-sentence.
finding.prototype: DR1 prints the same information in one shape whatever the count — "Show 1-4 of 4 results", or "Show 0 of 0 results" when there are none (app/views/dashboard.html:236). The range and the total are always both present, and results is lower case.
finding.difference: Replace the four phrasings with DR1's two: a range-and-total line, and a zero line. The count is already worked out and already rendered in that position, so this is the wording and the shape of the sentence, not the arithmetic.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the frontend dashboard printing a results line that carries both the range and the total when there is exactly one notification.
finding.verification: Written during the verification pass, not by the slice's author, from the same sweep of the results toolbar that produced dashboard--sort-options. Read both rendered DOMs (fe-dashboard-populated.html:141 renders "Showing 1 Result"; dr1-dashboard.html:665 renders "Show 1-4 of 4 results") and both screenshots, where the two lines sit in the same position above the list. Opened dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:40-46, dashboard/template.njk:61 and app/views/dashboard.html:236, and read the prototype's builder at app/routes.js:6700-6714 to confirm DR1 has only the two shapes rather than a per-count set the capture happens not to show. The named control is the literal string the frontend renders on the screen listed, so it crops. Band frontend-work: it is a copy leaf and a template line.
